title: Ownership
description: Artists should build equity in the work they create. QFR treats ownership as a starting principle and designs partnerships with a path toward greater artist control over masters, publishing and catalogs.

title: Freedom
description: There is no QFR house sound, predetermined commercial lane or requirement to become something an artist is not. The music leads.

title: Partnership
description: QFR succeeds when its artists succeed. The label contributes resources, expertise, technology and infrastructure while the artist remains at the center of the creative process.

title: Transparency
description: Money, recoupment, rights, responsibilities and expectations should be understandable before an agreement is signed and visible throughout the relationship.

title: Patience
description: Great records do not operate on quarterly deadlines. QFR would rather develop something remarkable slowly than release something unfinished simply because the calendar says it is time.

title: Innovation
description: Technology is a tool for expanding what artists can create, release and experience—not a replacement for creative intent.

title: Craft
description: Songs, performances, recordings, artwork, videos and live experiences deserve attention to detail because the catalog should still matter years after release day.

title: Integrity
description: QFR believes a successful label should be able to make money without treating artists as inventory, creative work as disposable product or relationships as transactions.

title: Growth
description: The goal is sustainable success rather than short-term extraction, creating opportunities for artists, the label and the wider roster to grow together.
